descriptionHtml:
Meetion BTM010R Right-Handed Ergonomic Dual Mode Wireless Mouse Black Edition (Dual Wireless Connection Bluetooth & 2.4GHz USB / Vertical Ergonomic Handshake Shape / RGB Breathing Illumination / Silent Soft-Click Switches / 4-Level Adjustable 2400 DPI Sensor / Built-in 700mAh Rechargeable Battery / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Protect your wrist and enhance everyday comfort with the Meetion BTM010R Right-Handed Ergonomic Dual Mode Wireless Mouse in Black Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Specifically engineered for right-handed users to support a natural handshake posture, the BTM010R combines dual-mode wireless freedom (Bluetooth & 2.4GHz USB), dynamic RGB backlighting, quiet silent switches, a high-capacity 700mAh rechargeable battery, and precise 2400 DPI tracking.
